response.original_title: How do I add a passenger on a Seabourn Cruise?
response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing Seabourn cruise reservation, you must call Seabourn Customer Service at 1-855-732-4023 (US/Canada) or +44 (289) 708-0062 (UK), or contact your travel advisor, as this cannot be completed online or through the mobile app.  Key Requirements & Rules  Capacity Limits: Adding a guest depends on whether your current suite has physical capacity (such as a sofa bed or pull-out berth) and whether the ship's overall section/lifeboat muster capacity allows another person.  Re-Pricing: The booking will typically be re-priced at current prevailing rates, and additional port taxes or fees will apply for the new guest.  Required Information: Have your booking number ready, along with the new passenger’s full legal name, date of birth, and loyalty or Captain's Circle number (if applicable).  Timing: It is best to request additions well before your final payment date or before final manifest data is submitted (usually 24 to 72 hours before departure).
